property_summary: For any sequence of admissible calls, if a call does not result in a full transfer (i.e., no transfer occurs), then the contract's balance does not decrease; the buggy version violates this because removing the msg.value requirement allows pastBlockTime to be updated and a transfer to be triggered even without 10 ether, causing an unexpected balance decrease when block.number % 15 == 0.
change_summary: Remove the msg.value requirement so fallback can be called with any amount or plain Ether transfers, changing when pastBlockTime is updated and transfers happen.
